shloka_text: तेषां समुपविष्टानां सर्वेषां दीनचेतसाम् । उवाच वाक्यं काकुत्स्थो मुखेन परिशुष्यता ।। 7.45.1 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dīnacetasām | uvāca vākyaṃ kākutstho mukhena pariśuṣyatā || 7.45.1 ||
translation: तेषां of them, समुपविष्टानां who were seated, सर्वेषां of all, दीनचेतसाम् whose minds were distressed, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha (Rama), परिशुष्यता drying up, मुखेन with his face, वाक्यं a word, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Rama, with a face parched by sorrow, spoke to all those who were seated before him with distressed minds.
comments: Rama discloses to his brothers the people's scandal against Sita and the unbearable infamy it brings, though he knows her pure, her innocence proven by fire and attested by the gods -- dreading dishonour above all, he commands Lakshmana to take Sita on the morrow and abandon her near Valmiki's hermitage on the Ganga, forbidding all argument, and withdraws sighing in grief.

shloka_text: सर्वे शृणुत भद्रं वो मा कुरुध्वं मनो ऽन्यथा । पौराणां मम सीतायां यादृशी वर्तते कथा ।। 7.45.2 ।।
transliteration: sarve śṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo mā kurudhvaṃ mano 'nyathā | paurāṇāṃ mama sītāyāṃ yādṛśī vartate kathā || 7.45.2 ||
translation: सर्वे all (of you), शृणुत listen, वः to you, भद्रं welfare (may there be), मनो mind, अन्यथा otherwise, मा do not, कुरुध्वं make, पौराणां of the citizens, मम my, सीतायां regarding Sita, यादृशी what kind of, कथा talk, वर्तते exists.
explanation: He asked them all to listen, wishing them well, and not to misunderstand, as he was about to reveal the kind of talk that existed among the citizens concerning his Sita.

shloka_text: पौरापवादः सुमहांस्तथा जनपदस्य च । वर्तते मयि बीभत्सा सा मे मर्माणि कृन्तति ।। 7.45.3 ।।
transliteration: paurāpavādaḥ sumahāṃstathā janapadasya ca | vartate mayi bībhatsā sā me marmāṇi kṛntati || 7.45.3 ||
translation: सुमहांस् very great, पौरापवादः scandal of the citizens, तथा and, जनपदस्य of the people of the country, च and, बीभत्सा disgusting (talk), मयि regarding me, वर्तते exists, सा that, मे my, मर्माणि vital parts, कृन्तति cuts.
explanation: A very great and abhorrent scandal from both the citizens and the people of the country exists concerning me, and that talk cuts into my very vitals.

shloka_text: अहं किल कुले जात इक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम् । सीता ऽपि सत्कुले जाता जनकानां महात्मनाम् ।। 7.45.4 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ kila kule jāta ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahātmanām | sītā 'pi satkule jātā janakānāṃ mahātmanām || 7.45.4 ||
translation: अहं I, किल indeed, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, कुले in the family, जात born, सीता Sita, अपि also, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, जनकानां of the Janakas, सत्कुले in a noble family, जाता born.
explanation: He stated that he was born in the family of the great-souled Ikshvakus, and Sita too was born in the noble family of the great-souled Janakas.

shloka_text: जानासि त्वं यथा सौम्य दण्डके विजने वने । रावणेन हृता सीता स च विध्वंसितो मया ।। 7.45.5 ।।
transliteration: jānāsi tvaṃ yathā saumya daṇḍake vijane vane | rāvaṇena hṛtā sītā sa ca vidhvaṃsito mayā || 7.45.5 ||
translation: सौम्य O gentle one, त्वं you, जानासि know, यथा how, दण्डके in Dandaka, विजने solitary, वने in the forest, सीता Sita, रावणेन by Ravana, हृता was abducted, च and, स he (Ravana), मया by me, विध्वंसितो was destroyed.
explanation: He reminded them, "O gentle one, you know how Sita was abducted by Ravana in the solitary Dandaka forest, and how I subsequently destroyed him."

shloka_text: तत्र मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना जनकस्य सुतां प्रति । अत्रोषितामिमां सीतामानयेयं कथं पुरीम् ।। 7.45.6 ।।
transliteration: tatra me buddhirutpannā janakasya sutāṃ prati | atroṣitāmimāṃ sītāmānayeyaṃ kathaṃ purīm || 7.45.6 ||
translation: तत्र there, मे my, बुद्धिः thought, उत्पन्ना arose, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुताम् daughter, प्रति regarding, अत्र here, उषिताम् having resided, इमाम् this, सीताम् Sita, आनयेयम् I should bring, कथम् how, पुरीम् to the city.
explanation: At that time, a thought arose in my mind concerning Janaka's daughter, Sita, wondering how I could bring this Sita, who had resided here, back to the city.

shloka_text: प्रत्ययार्थं ततः सीता विवेश ज्वलनं तदा । प्रत्यक्षं तव सौमित्रे देवानां हव्यवाहनः । अपापां मैथिलीमाह वायुश्चाकाशगोचरः ।। 7.45.7 ।।
transliteration: pratyayārthaṃ tataḥ sītā viveśa jvalanaṃ tadā | pratyakṣaṃ tava saumitre devānāṃ havyavāhanaḥ | apāpāṃ maithilīmāha vāyuścākāśagocaraḥ || 7.45.7 ||
translation: प्रत्ययार्थम् for the sake of proof, ततः then, सीता Sita, विवेश entered, ज्वलनम् fire, तदा then, प्रत्यक्षम् in the presence of, तव your, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, देवानाम् of the gods, हव्यवाहनः the fire-god, अपापाम् sinless, मैथिलीम् Maithili, आह declared, वायुः the wind-god, च and, आकाशगोचरः moving in the sky.
explanation: Then, for the sake of proof, Sita entered the fire, and in your presence, O Lakshmana, the fire-god and the wind-god, who moves in the sky, declared Maithili to be sinless.

shloka_text: चन्द्रादित्यौ च शंसेते सुराणां सन्निधौ पुरा । ऋषीणां चैव सर्वेषामपापां जनकात्मजाम् ।। 7.45.8 ।।
transliteration: candrādityau ca śaṃsete surāṇāṃ sannidhau purā | ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāmapāpāṃ janakātmajām || 7.45.8 ||
translation: चन्द्रादित्यौ the moon and the sun, च and, शंसेते declared, सुराणाम् of the gods, सन्निधौ in the presence, पुरा formerly, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, च and, एव indeed, सर्वेषाम् of all, अपापाम् sinless, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter.
explanation: Furthermore, the moon and the sun, in the presence of all the gods and sages, formerly declared Janaka's daughter to be sinless.

shloka_text: एवं शुद्धसमाचारा देवगन्धर्वसन्निधौ । लङ्काद्वीपे महेन्द्रेण मम हस्ते निवेशिता ।। 7.45.9 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ śuddhasamācārā devagandharvasannidhau | laṅkādvīpe mahendreṇa mama haste niveśitā || 7.45.9 ||
translation: एवम् thus, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, देवगन्धर्वसन्निधौ in the presence of gods and Gandharvas, लङ्काद्वीपे on the island of Lanka, महेन्द्रेण by the great Indra, मम my, हस्ते in the hand, निवेशिता placed.
explanation: Thus, she of pure conduct was entrusted into my hands by the great Indra himself on the island of Lanka, in the presence of gods and Gandharvas.

shloka_text: अन्तरात्मा च मे वेत्ति सीतां शुद्धां यशस्विनीम् । ततो गृहीत्वा वैदेहीमयोध्यामहमागतः ।। 7.45.10 ।।
transliteration: antarātmā ca me vetti sītāṃ śuddhāṃ yaśasvinīm | tato gṛhītvā vaidehīmayodhyāmahamāgataḥ || 7.45.10 ||
translation: अन्तरात्मा my inner self, च and, मे my, वेत्ति knows, सीताम् Sita, शुद्धाम् pure, यशस्विनीम् glorious, ततः then, गृहीत्वा having taken, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, अहम् I, आगतः came.
explanation: And my inner self knows Sita to be pure and glorious, so thereafter, I brought Vaidehi to Ayodhya.

shloka_text: अयं तु मे महान्वादः शोकश्च हृदि वर्तते । पौरापवादः सुमहांस्तथा जनपदस्य च ।। 7.45.11 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ tu me mahānvādaḥ śokaśca hṛdi vartate | paurāpavādaḥ sumahāṃstathā janapadasya ca || 7.45.11 ||
translation: अयं this, तु indeed, मे my, महान् great, वादः accusation, शोकः sorrow, च and, हृदि in the heart, वर्तते exists, पौरापवादः the slander of the citizens, सुमहान् very great, तथा and, जनपदस्य of the country, च also.
explanation: This great accusation and sorrow, which is the very great slander of the citizens and the people of the country, exists in my heart.

shloka_text: अकीर्तिर्यस्य गीयेत लोके भूतस्य कस्यचित् । पतत्येवाधमाँल्लोकान्यावच्छब्दः प्रकीर्त्यते ।। 7.45.12 ।।
transliteration: akīrtiryasya gīyeta loke bhūtasya kasyacit | patatyevādhamāँllokānyāvacchabdaḥ prakīrtyate || 7.45.12 ||
translation: अकीर्तिः infamy, यस्य whose, गीयेत is sung, लोके in the world, भूतस्य of a being, कस्यचित् any, पतति falls, एव indeed, अधमान् to lower, लोकान् worlds, यावत् as long as, शब्दः the word, प्रकीर्त्यते is proclaimed.
explanation: Any being whose infamy is spoken of in the world falls to lower realms as long as that word of disgrace is proclaimed.

shloka_text: अकीर्तिर्निन्द्यते देवैः कीर्तिर्लोकेषु पूज्यते । कीर्त्यर्थं तु समारम्भः सर्वेषां सुमहात्मनाम् ।। 7.45.13 ।।
transliteration: akīrtirnindyate devaiḥ kīrtirlokeṣu pūjyate | kīrtyarthaṃ tu samārambhaḥ sarveṣāṃ sumahātmanām || 7.45.13 ||
translation: अकीर्तिः infamy, निन्द्यते is condemned, देवैः by the gods, कीर्तिः fame, लोकेषु in the worlds, पूज्यते is honored, कीर्त्यर्थम् for the sake of fame, तु indeed, समारम्भः the undertaking, सर्वेषाम् of all, सुमहात्मनाम् great-souled ones.
explanation: Infamy is condemned by the gods, while fame is honored in all worlds, and indeed, all great-souled individuals undertake their endeavors for the sake of renown.

shloka_text: अप्यहं जीवितं जह्यां युष्मान्वा पुरुषर्षभाः । अपवादभयाद्भीतः किं पुनर्जनकात्मजाम् ।। 7.45.14 ।।
transliteration: apyahaṃ jīvitaṃ jahyāṃ yuṣmānvā puruṣarṣabhāḥ | apavādabhayādbhītaḥ kiṃ punarjanakātmajām || 7.45.14 ||
translation: अपि even, अहम् I, जीवितम् life, जह्याम् would abandon, युष्मान् you, वा or, पुरुषर्षभाः O best among men, अपवादभयात् from the fear of slander, भीतः afraid, किम् what, पुनर् then, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter.
explanation: O best among men, I, being afraid of the fear of slander, would even abandon my life or you all, so what then of Janaka's daughter?

shloka_text: तस्माद्भवन्तः पश्यन्तु पतितं शोकसागरे । नहि पश्याम्यहं भूतं किञ्चिद्दुःखमतो ऽधिकम् ।। 7.45.15 ।।
transliteration: tasmādbhavantaḥ paśyantu patitaṃ śokasāgare | nahi paśyāmyahaṃ bhūtaṃ kiñcidduḥkhamato 'dhikam || 7.45.15 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, भवन्तः you, पश्यन्तु may see, पतितम् fallen, शोकसागरे in the ocean of sorrow, न not, हि indeed, पश्याम्यहम् I see, भूतं existing, किञ्चित् any, दुःखम् sorrow, अतः than this, अधिकम् greater.
explanation: Therefore, you should see me fallen into an ocean of sorrow, for I indeed do not see any existing sorrow greater than this.

shloka_text: श्वस्त्वं प्रभाते सौमित्रे सुमन्त्राधिष्ठितं रथम् । आरुह्य सीतामारोप्य विषयान्ते समुत्सृज ।। 7.45.16 ।।
transliteration: śvastvaṃ prabhāte saumitre sumantrādhiṣṭhitaṃ ratham | āruhya sītāmāropya viṣayānte samutsṛja || 7.45.16 ||
translation: श्वः tomorrow, त्वं you, प्रभाते in the morning, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, सुमन्त्राधिष्ठितं driven by Sumantra, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, सीताम् Sita, आरोप्य having made to ascend, विषयान्ते at the border of the kingdom, समुत्सृज abandon.
explanation: O Lakshmana, tomorrow morning, you must ascend the chariot driven by Sumantra, place Sita in it, and abandon her at the border of the kingdom.

shloka_text: गङ्गायास्तु परे पारे वाल्मीकेस्तु महात्मनः । आश्रमो दिव्यसङ्काशस्तमसातीरमाश्रितः ।। 7.45.17 ।।
transliteration: gaṅgāyāstu pare pāre vālmīkestu mahātmanaḥ | āśramo divyasaṅkāśastamasātīramāśritaḥ || 7.45.17 ||
translation: गङ्गायाः of Ganga, तु indeed, परे on the other, पारे bank, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, तु indeed, महात्मनः of the great soul, आश्रमः hermitage, दिव्यसङ्काशः divine-looking, तमसातीरम् the bank of Tamasa, आश्रितः situated.
explanation: On the other bank of the Ganga, there is the divine-looking hermitage of the great sage Valmiki, situated on the banks of the Tamasa river.

shloka_text: तत्रैनां विजने देशे विसृज्य रघुनन्दन । शीघ्रमागच्छ भद्रं ते कुरुष्व वचनं मम ।। 7.45.18 ।।
transliteration: tatraināṃ vijane deśe visṛjya raghunandana | śīghramāgaccha bhadraṃ te kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama || 7.45.18 ||
translation: तत्र there, एनां her, विजने solitary, देशे in the place, विसृज्य having abandoned, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu dynasty, शीघ्रम् quickly, आगच्छ come back, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, कुरुष्व do, वचनं command, मम my.
explanation: O Lakshmana, having abandoned her there in that solitary place, return quickly; may good fortune be yours, and carry out my command.

shloka_text: न चास्मिन् प्रतिवक्तव्यः सीतां प्रति कथञ्चन । तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ सौमित्रे नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।। 7.45.19 ।।
transliteration: na cāsmin prativaktavyaḥ sītāṃ prati kathañcana | tasmāttvaṃ gaccha saumitre nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 7.45.19 ||
translation: न not, च and, अस्मिन् in this matter, प्रतिवक्तव्यः to be argued against, सीतां Sita, प्रति regarding, कथञ्चन in any way, तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, गच्छ go, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, न not, अत्र here, कार्या to be done, विचारणा deliberation.
explanation: And regarding Sita, you must not argue against this command in any way; therefore, O Lakshmana, go, for no deliberation is to be done in this matter.

shloka_text: अप्रीतिर्हि परा मह्यं त्वयेतत्प्रतिवारिते । शापिता हि मया यूयं भुजाभ्यां जीवितेन च ।। 7.45.20 ।।
transliteration: aprītirhi parā mahyaṃ tvayetatprativārite | śāpitā hi mayā yūyaṃ bhujābhyāṃ jīvitena ca || 7.45.20 ||
translation: अप्रीतिः displeasure, हि indeed, परा great, मह्यं to me, त्वया by you, एतत् this, प्रतिवारिते if opposed, शापिता sworn, हि indeed, मया by me, यूयं you all, भुजाभ्यां by my arms, जीवितेन by my life, च and.
explanation: Indeed, great displeasure will befall me if you oppose this, for I have made you all swear by my arms and by my very life.

shloka_text: ये मां वाक्यान्तरे ब्रूयुरनुनेतुं कथञ्चन । अहिता नाम ते नित्यं मदभीष्टविघातनात् ।। 7.45.21 ।।
transliteration: ye māṃ vākyāntare brūyuranunetuṃ kathañcana | ahitā nāma te nityaṃ madabhīṣṭavighātanāt || 7.45.21 ||
translation: ये those who, मां me, वाक्यान्तरे with other words, ब्रूयुः would speak, अनुनेतुम् to persuade, कथञ्चन in any way, अहिताः enemies, नाम indeed, ते they, नित्यम् always, मदभीष्टविघातनात् because of obstructing my desire.
explanation: Those who would speak to me with other words, attempting to persuade me in any way, are indeed always my enemies because they obstruct my desire.

shloka_text: मानयन्तु भवन्तो मां यदि मच्छासने स्थिताः । इतो ऽद्य नीयतां सीता कुरुष्व वचनं मम ।। 7.45.22 ।।
transliteration: mānayantu bhavanto māṃ yadi macchāsane sthitāḥ | ito 'dya nīyatāṃ sītā kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama || 7.45.22 ||
translation: मानयन्तु let them respect, भवन्तः you, मां me, यदि if, मच्छासने in my command, स्थिताः established, इतः from here, अद्य today, नीयताम् let her be taken, सीता Sita, कुरुष्व do, वचनम् the command, मम my.
explanation: If you abide by my command, then respect me; let Sita be taken from here today, and obey my word.

shloka_text: पूर्वमुक्तो ऽहमनया गङ्गातीरे ऽहमाश्रमान् । पश्येयमिति तस्याश्च कामः संवर्त्यतामयम् ।। 7.45.23 ।।
transliteration: pūrvamukto 'hamanayā gaṅgātīre 'hamāśramān | paśyeyamiti tasyāśca kāmaḥ saṃvartyatāmayam || 7.45.23 ||
translation: पूर्वम् previously, उक्तः said, अहम् I, अनया by her, गङ्गातीरे on the bank of the Ganga, अहम् I, आश्रमान् hermitages, पश्येयम् may see, इति thus, तस्याः her, च and, कामः desire, संवर्त्यताम् let it be fulfilled, अयम् this.
explanation: She had previously told me that she wished to see the hermitages on the bank of the Ganga, so let this desire of hers be fulfilled.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थो बाष्पेण पिहिताननः । प्रविवेश स धर्मात्मा भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः ।। 7.45.24 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu kākutstho bāṣpeṇa pihitānanaḥ | praviveśa sa dharmātmā bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 7.45.24 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, बाष्पेण with tears, पिहिताननः having his face covered, प्रविवेश entered, सः he, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, भ्रातृभिः by his brothers, परिवारितः surrounded.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Rama, the righteous one, with his face covered in tears, entered, surrounded by his brothers.

shloka_text: शोकसंलग्नहृदयो निशश्वास यथा द्विपः ।। 7.45.25 ।।
transliteration: śokasaṃlagnahṛdayo niśaśvāsa yathā dvipaḥ || 7.45.25 ||
translation: शोकसंलग्नहृदयः with a heart engulfed by sorrow, निशश्वास he sighed, यथा like, द्विपः an elephant.
explanation: With his heart engulfed by sorrow, he sighed like an elephant. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 45 ।। Thus ends the forty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
